notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
- fix Tutorial Button rendering order 
- Adjust music sync for Bubble

- New stage: LEMONADE - Hard Winter Festival
- Add 2x speed mode: If you start with left Shift pressed, it will be played at 2x speed. However, there is no achievement and it does not affect the ranking.
- From now, You can press F5 to quickly restart the game.
- The beats and save points of in Sparky!, Shattered Universe, and Free! are slightly adjusted.
- A button will be added to open the tutorial.

- New Stage: Kennyeon - Summertime 
- Hardmode Ranking Refreshed.
I dropped previous Leaderboard for debugging, So scoreboard have been reset.
But you can re-submitted your score when you run the client.
Don't be worried that you lose your game reocrd!

- Remove some save points in Stage 1~15
- Add Bloom Effect On/Off option on setting panel
- Modify Patterns of "Child" And "Star Candy"
- Modify screen effects on some stages.  (Child, Star candy, Sparky!)

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
- New Song: Yuarkin - Sparky!
- You can turn off the "Miss on mute" effect in the setting panel now.
- Tutorial pop-up is Added. It will be pop-up when you launch the game for the first time.

- pattern fix: Free!
- pattern fix: Physical Emotion
- Ending credit fix: HEAVYGiant->HEAVYgiant
- Add "LOADING..." Text when change the scene from sync scene to song select scene
- Achievement text fix: (No Death: ? ->No Death: Pastel Regression, MIRAY: ? ->MIRAY: Pastel Regression)
